title: Fix broken Smithery directory links and accurately audit legacy ReMCP package copies.
changes: Remove the retired Smithery discovery badge and broken 404 links from public documentation; point readers to Smithery's shutdown notice and working Glama / official MCP Registry options.
Detect real installed @remcp/remcp package roots from current service, invoked CLI and bounded historical paths; deduplicate shell aliases and ignore files absent after Node.js upgrades.

Make remcp status report verified package-copy counts rather than implying concurrent agents. Add read-only remcp doctor inventory of client/runtime versions, historical npm/npx copies, alias paths and explicit process-usage uncertainty.
Preserve the canonical managed agent, pairing, Node.js installations and all unrelated npm packages. Do not silently clean up old ReMCP copies or turn on unrestricted access.
Ship regressions in both private CI and the projected public client, including a test that no longer demands a deleted Smithery badge.
